title: One-page spotcheck cheatsheet and owners
content:
Purpose: tiny cross-functional checklist used during ad-hoc runs and handoffs. Keep to 1 page, readable in 30s.

How to use:
- Run a spotcheck on listed items during pre-release / surge windows.
- Mark LastChecked with initials and date, short note if follow-up needed.
- Escalation: if Confidence <= 60% open a quick ticket with prefix SPOT/ + owner.

Columns (sheet view):
RowID | Area | Item short name | Owner | Owner email | LastChecked | Status (OK/Defer/Fail) | Confidence% | Quick action | Notes / ticket ref
1 | Routing | regional-fallback-config | Arjun Patel | arjun@redwood.com | 2027-08-09 (AP) | OK | 90 | none | sampling across eu-west verified
2 | Quotas | per-route-throttle | Nora Wallace | nora@redwood.com | 2027-07-28 (NW) | Defer | 55 | SPOT-203 | observed burst on beta key, needs limit tweak
3 | Logs | audit-ingestion-lag | Diego Ramos | diego@redwood.com | 2027-08-03 (DR) | Fail | 40 | SPOT-207 | backlog on ingest cluster, see OPS-1427
4 | Cost | hot-embedding-cache | Maya Chen | maya@redwood.com | 2027-08-01 (MC) | OK | 80 | none | cache hit ratio 0.72 last 24h

Quick heuristics:
- <60% Confidence -> short ticket + ping owner and #ops-spotchecks.
- If status Fail -> mark P0 in tickets if user-visible.
- If Defer -> add expected check date in Notes.

Notes to self (working):
- Consider adding a small sparkline for confidence history next iteration.
- Might fold this into weekly cadence doc but keep this sheet sticky for ad-hoc runs.
- Follow-up items: schedule 30-min sync with infra-owner (Arjun) to triage SPOT-203.

One-liner summary for execs (copyable):
- "Mini spotcheck snapshot: 4 items checked, 1 fail (audit-ingestion-lag), 1 defer (per-route-throttle). Immediate ticket SPOT-207 created; contact Arjun/Nora for triage."

Recent changes:
- 2027-08-09: added Confidence column and simple heuristics (Maya).
- 2027-08-03: initial table import from handoff notes (Arjun).

Unresolved questions:
- Do we want to include SLA impact estimate (time-to-fix) in this sheet? (Y/N)
- Should customer-facing items be tagged separately?

Checklist before closing a SPOT ticket:
- [ ] Owner assigned
- [ ] Short mitigation in ticket description
- [ ] Visible metric update within 24h (if user-facing)
- [ ] Notify product-ops channel

End of mini-cheatsheet.
